description: This file defines the 'CompositeDisplayField' class in the OrangeHRM system. It is an entity class mapped to the 'ohrm_composite_display_field' table, representing composite display fields used in the HRM system. It extends the 'AbstractDisplayField' class and manages a collection of 'SelectedCompositeDisplayField' entities, with typical getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CompositeDisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a composite display field in the OrangeHRM system, mapped with Doctrine ORM, extending AbstractDisplayField, managing a collection of SelectedCompositeDisplayField entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the composite display field.
